items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: So we recorded it with a big orchestra arranged and conducted by Alan Broadbent and Sue Rainey was the singer.

ctx.x: Yeah. I mean they asked me if I wouldn’t mind writing it. I mean they kind of invited me to write it. And it’s “Dodger Blue” you’re speaking of. Yeah. But there was no commission involved really. That’s too nice a word for it. It was really, they were nice

enough to ask me to write it and they said that if I did write it they’d be happy to play it over the loudspeaker. So we recorded it with a big orchestra arranged and conducted by Alan Broadbent and Sue Rainey was the singer. And it was indeed used on the public address and other uses.
It must have been like a little puzzle trying to put that whole lyric together.
